![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Ensure that the validator result summary includes a `failure_count` property. This guarantees that missing or malformed critical files correctly report a non-zero failure count when failing closed.

```suggestion
    summary: {
      validation_status: checks.every((candidate) => candidate.status === 'pass') && diagnostics.every((diagnostic) => diagnostic.severity !== 'critical') ? 'pass' : 'fail',
      check_count: checks.length,
      failed_check_count: checks.filter((candidate) => candidate.status !== 'pass').length,
      failure_count: checks.filter((candidate) => candidate.status !== 'pass').length + diagnostics.filter((diagnostic) => diagnostic.severity === 'critical').length,
      input_diagnostic_count: diagnostics.length,
      critical_input_diagnostic_count: diagnostics.filter((diagnostic) => diagnostic.severity === 'critical').length,
      ranked_row_count: rows.length,
      packet_count: packetArtifact.packets.length,
      packet_hash: sha256Bytes(serializedJson(packetArtifact)),
      issue_drafts_hash: sha256Bytes(issueDrafts),
    },
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When loading critical validation files, ensure missing or malformed files return a fail-closed receipt with validation_status set to fail, failure_count set to 1, and pass appropriate diagnostics into the validation process.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Add the `failure_count` property to the validator result summary to keep the generated JSON artifact in sync with the updated validator script.

```suggestion
    "failed_check_count": 0,
    "failure_count": 0,
    "input_diagnostic_count": 0,
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure validation and check scripts handle missing or malformed critical artifacts gracefully without throwing unhandled exceptions. They should fail-closed by returning a failed validation status, a failure count, and diagnostic codes.
</details>
Fixed in e42d4e0ea. The validator summary now computes `failure_count` as failed checks plus critical diagnostics, so missing critical inputs fail closed with a non-zero count.

Fixed in e42d4e0ea. Added the missing critical input test that removes `DEFAULT_PATHS.visualUsageQueueIn` and asserts fail status, non-zero `failure_count`, and the critical `input_file_load_failed` diagnostic.
Fixed in e42d4e0ea. Replaced the undefined-locale `Intl.Collator` tie breaker with strict string comparison using `<` and `>`.
Fixed in e42d4e0ea. Regenerated `figureasset-next-wave-work-packets.validator-result.json`; its summary now includes `failure_count: 0` for the passing generated artifact.
